annotations.title: Check GPSR information for an online offer

description: Use this when someone sells consumer products online and wants to know which manufacturer and product details their offer must show under Art. 19 GPSR, or wants their details checked and turned into a text block. Called without details it lists what is required. Checks the information an online offer to consumers needs under Art. 19 GPSR (manufacturer, postal address, electronic address, product identifier, responsible person in the EU for manufacturers outside it) for formal completeness and returns it as a text block. Nothing is stored. Do not use for CLP hazard labels (use clp_label_dimensions or search_knowledge) or for offers to businesses only, which Art. 19 GPSR does not cover.

country.description: ISO country code of the manufacturer, e.g. "AT", "CN"

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

manufacturer.description: Name of the manufacturer. Leave out to get the list of what is required

name: check_gpsr_information
title: Check GPSR information for an online offer
